Class AlgoMessageAlertRetentionService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.AlgoMessageAlertRetentionService
@Service public class AlgoMessageAlertRetentionService extends Object
Bounds the recorded alert notifications, which would otherwise grow without limit per tenant. The user deletes selected notifications, and once per server day the alert background task (AlgoAlarmIndicatorEvaluationTask) applies the retention of gt.algo.alert.retention as its last step, after the delivery of its notifications.

A notification is not only history: its row, unique per signal identity and alert day, is the only guard against the same alarm being raised and sent again. Neither path therefore removes a notification whose alert day lies within the last GlobalParamKeyDefault.ALGO_ALERT_PROTECTED_DAYS days, nor one whose delivery has not finished, since that would lose the message silently or race the delivery that holds its lease.

  • Method Details

    • isDeletable

      public static boolean isDeletable(AlgoMessageAlert alert, LocalDate today)
      Whether the user may delete the notification today. The same rule the delete statements apply, offered to the client so it can disable the action instead of letting it fail.
      Parameters:
      alert - the recorded notification
      today - the current server day
      Returns:
      true when its delivery has finished and its alert day lies before the protected window

    • deleteByUser

      @Transactional public int deleteByUser(Integer idTenant, List<Integer> ids)
      Deletes the notifications the user has selected. The selection is deleted completely or not at all: when one of them is protected or belongs to another tenant, nothing is deleted and the user learns why.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - the home tenant of the user
      ids - the selected notifications
      Returns:
      the number of deleted notifications

    • isPurgeDue

      public boolean isPurgeDue()
      Whether the retention has not yet run on the current server day. Lets the alert background task be scheduled once a day for the retention alone, even when no alert, rebalancing or delivery is due.
      Returns:
      true until purge() has completed today

    • purge

      @Transactional public void purge()
      Applies the retention: first the age limit, then the record limit per tenant, and finally removes the notifications of deleted strategies. Called by the alert background task when isPurgeDue(); a run that fails leaves the day unmarked, so the next run of the task tries again.
